pages: Håkon Sandvik, a boy of fourteen, dark hair, in a thick navy-blue knitted jumper with the sleeves pushed up holds one cloth-bound logbook open on both palms, reading the writing on the inside cover. Middle distance: van keys on the bench, a tin mug gone cold. Background: the small window, a low red glow over a snow ridge.

Håkon Sandvik, a boy of fourteen, dark hair, in a thick navy-blue knitted jumper with the sleeves pushed up stands beside one dark blue estate van with its side door open, hands pushed into his pockets. Middle distance: gravel underfoot, a pair of van keys on the ground. Background: black sea to the left, night coming down behind the island.

Håkon Sandvik, a boy of fourteen, dark hair, in a thick navy-blue knitted jumper with the sleeves pushed up kneels on the gravel shelf, writing in one open notebook on his knee with one ballpoint pen. Middle distance: the old farm's dark wall, a folded tripod. Background: a low red band along the northern ridge, soft at the edges.

Håkon Sandvik, a boy of fourteen, dark hair, in a thick navy-blue knitted jumper with the sleeves pushed up stands beside the open side door of the van, one hand flat on the cold metal frame, watching north. Middle distance: the van's dark flank, its open door. Background: the band over the ridge, its lower edge gone grey.

Håkon Sandvik, a boy of fourteen, dark hair, in a thick navy-blue knitted jumper with the sleeves pushed up holds one open logbook turned round, one finger resting on a ruled column of figures, his face lit warm from below. Middle distance: one stopwatch on the seat, the heater's grille. Background: the band over the ridge, red going nameless.

Håkon Sandvik, a boy of fourteen, dark hair, in a thick navy-blue knitted jumper with the sleeves pushed up leans to one small finder telescope on a tripod, sighting along the ridge line, one hand at the eyepiece. Middle distance: one stopwatch on the tailgate. Background: a lattice mast and a notch in the hill above it.

Håkon Sandvik, a boy of fourteen, dark hair, in a thick navy-blue knitted jumper with the sleeves pushed up closes one notebook with the elastic band round it and holds it flat against his chest, eyes still on the sky. Middle distance: the folded tripod, gravel. Background: a green band standing low over the ridge without rays.

Håkon Sandvik, a boy of fourteen, dark hair, in a thick navy-blue knitted jumper with the sleeves pushed up sits in the back of the van, one notebook open flat on his knee, one finger down a column of seconds. Middle distance: the seat back, the dash. Background: through the windscreen, the band over the ridge, greying at its foot.

Håkon Sandvik, a boy of fourteen, dark hair, in a thick navy-blue knitted jumper with the sleeves pushed up sits in the back of the moving van with one notebook shut on his knees, face lifted to the glow coming through the glass. Middle distance: the seat frame, a folded blanket. Background: the climbing road, the black sea below.

Håkon Sandvik, a boy of fourteen, dark hair, in a thick navy-blue knitted jumper with the sleeves pushed up writes a long column of figures in one open logbook on the tailgate, pen cap between his teeth. Middle distance: one stopwatch beside the book, a stone off the shelf. Background: the sky breaking open, green rays over red.

Håkon Sandvik, a boy of fourteen, dark hair, in a thick navy-blue knitted jumper with the sleeves pushed up sits with one closed logbook against his chest in the warm van, looking out at the road going down. Middle distance: the dashboard dial, a paper cup. Background: the sea on the left, the last faint green overhead.

Håkon Sandvik, a boy of fourteen, dark hair, in a thick navy-blue knitted jumper with the sleeves pushed up stands at the harbour rail with one notebook braced on the stone, writing, the dark water behind him. Middle distance: a folded map weighted with a stone, bollards. Background: the ridge opposite, a thin green foot low on it.

Håkon Sandvik, a boy of fourteen, dark hair, in a thick navy-blue knitted jumper with the sleeves pushed up sits in the van with one notebook flat on his knee, working in the dark, eyes up through the windscreen. Middle distance: the folded map, the wheel. Background: the notch in the ridge, the green band above it.

Håkon Sandvik, a boy of fourteen, dark hair, in a thick navy-blue knitted jumper with the sleeves pushed up sits with one open notebook on his knee, a pencil-drawn figure ringed on the back leaf, staring at it. Middle distance: the folded map, one stopwatch. Background: the windscreen, the aurora in broad slow folds.

Håkon Sandvik, a boy of fourteen, dark hair, in a thick navy-blue knitted jumper with the sleeves pushed up kneels at the gravel shelf writing in one open logbook held against a stone, the pen moving fast. Middle distance: the tripod standing on end. Background: green hanging low off the ridge, a red band above it.

Håkon Sandvik, a boy of fourteen, dark hair, in a thick navy-blue knitted jumper with the sleeves pushed up sits under the red lamp on the gravel shelf with one open logbook on his knee, three short rows of pencil figures side by side. Middle distance: one stopwatch, the lamp's red bulb. Background: the dark ridge, stars, the folded tripod.

Håkon Sandvik, a boy of fourteen, dark hair, in a thick navy-blue knitted jumper with the sleeves pushed up stands at the workshop bench with one open logbook turned to face across it, one finger laid on a row of figures in the ruled column. Middle distance: steel-rimmed glasses, the bench vice. Background: the workshop window, frost, a red lamp.

Håkon Sandvik, a boy of fourteen, dark hair, in a thick navy-blue knitted jumper with the sleeves pushed up lays one steel stopwatch on the bench beside the open logbook, fingertip resting on its crown. Middle distance: the ruled column, an oil can. Background: the workshop window, frost white on the glass, the night pressing at it.

Håkon Sandvik, a boy of fourteen, dark hair, in a thick navy-blue knitted jumper with the sleeves pushed up sits at the bench with one open notebook before him, pen held still, the leaf of figures and a blank space under it. Middle distance: the stopwatch, a folded cloth. Background: the heater's red bar, the dark window.

Håkon Sandvik, a boy of fourteen, dark hair, in a thick navy-blue knitted jumper with the sleeves pushed up rubs one folded cloth over the inside cover of the open logbook, ink coming away under his thumb. Middle distance: the stopwatch, an ink bottle with a black cap. Background: the workshop bench, red lamp, frost on the window.

Håkon Sandvik, a boy of fourteen, dark hair, in a thick navy-blue knitted jumper with the sleeves pushed up sits on the gravel shelf with one open logbook on his knee, two numbers side by side, neither ringed. Middle distance: the finder telescope on its tripod, a stone on the leaf. Background: green hanging low over the black ridge.

Håkon Sandvik, a boy of fourteen, dark hair, in a thick navy-blue knitted jumper with the sleeves pushed up stands on the harbour quay holding one stopwatch up square to the sky, his arm wide for a bearing. Middle distance: the closed logbook, bollards and chain. Background: open sea, the far ridge, a high thin green.

Håkon Sandvik, a boy of fourteen, dark hair, in a thick navy-blue knitted jumper with the sleeves pushed up sets one closed logbook down on the workshop bench above the heater, both hands flat on the cover. Middle distance: the stopwatch, a coil of wire, the vice. Background: the window, frost, a last green arc.
